summary: Moved the legacy DeepSeek modelopt_fp4 NextN-to-BF16 decision out of the shared DeepseekModelNextN constructor and into DeepSeek's quant-config resolver. GLM-5.3 can now retain modelopt_fp4 for its quantized NextN layer, while checkpoint-declared unquantized GLM NextN layers and DeepSeek modelopt_fp4 NextN remain BF16. The original constructor behavior was reproduced directly: before the correction, the decoder received quant_config=None.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: 3 failures showed that the shared NextN constructor discarded modelopt_fp4 and the DeepSeek/GLM resolver boundary did not express the intended per-model behavior. Raw output: reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/evidence/regression-before.log

5 tests passed: GLM modelopt_fp4 reaches the decoder, DeepSeek modelopt_fp4 remains BF16, GLM whole-NextN exclusion remains BF16, GLM quantized NextN retains modelopt_fp4, and non-modelopt quantization is unchanged. Raw output: reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/evidence/regression-after.log

2 adjacent loader tests passed with 6 subtests, covering serialized/unserialized draft selection and ModelOpt workflow loader selection. Raw output: reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/evidence/related-loader-tests-passing.log

Two loader tests passed, while one configuration-routing test was blocked by the repository's explicit ROCm rejection of modelopt_fp4. Raw output: reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/evidence/related-loader-tests.log
The assigned device is one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) under torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2. Raw output: reports/j-fadd43cfc17a/evidence/gpu-environment.log

remaining_limitations: The GLM-5.3-Flash-NVFP4 weights were not available locally, so no full checkpoint load or speculative-serving reproduction was performed.

The assigned gfx950 GPU was identified, but SGLang explicitly rejects modelopt_fp4 on ROCm and the reported checkpoint/backend is NVIDIA ModelOpt FP4 on SM121; no GPU kernel or model inference was claimed.
The report used two NVIDIA DGX Spark nodes with TP2/EP2 and Marlin; this environment provides one AMD gfx950 GPU, so that distributed NVIDIA workload remains unverified.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture is not architecture- or quantization-equivalent and therefore was not used to claim GLM-5.3 or ModelOpt FP4 validation.

Open upstream PR https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/37322 addresses the same issue with a broader cross-model exclusion-mapping change; it was inspected but not copied wholesale into this narrow GLM-specific correction.
